universities.summary: Rathinam Global is a private deemed-to-be university at Rathinam Techzone in Eachanari, Coimbatore. The institution developed from Rathinam College of Arts and Science and currently advertises undergraduate, postgraduate and research study across commerce, computing, science and other schools. These listings cover three regular undergraduate awards with current programme-specific entry information.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Eachanari campus brings academic buildings, sports areas and learning facilities together within Rathinam Techzone. Applicants should confirm the facilities and timetable used by their selected department.
universities.cityProfile: Coimbatore is a city in western Tamil Nadu. The university is at Eachanari on Pollachi Road; compare accommodation and daily travel arrangements against the exact teaching location. Check transport costs and the route to the exact department before committing to accommodation.
universities.practicalExposure: The published computing and commerce programmes describe practical coursework, projects and software-based learning. Professional accounting offers an optional CA study pathway; the degree does not by itself confer Chartered Accountant status. Confirm current project, laboratory and coaching arrangements with the selected department.
universities.hostelOverview: The university publishes hostel information. Confirm room availability, accommodation charges and reporting arrangements directly before accepting a place.
universities.dietarySupport: Confirm current meal plans and any dietary requirements with the accommodation office; the programme fee should not be assumed to include meals.
universities.safetyOverview: Ask the university about residence access, emergency contacts and support arrangements for the exact campus and accommodation selected.
universities.studentSupport: Use the official admissions office for qualification verification, programme selection and current reporting instructions. Ask the department about learning arrangements and available support before confirming a place.
whyChoose: Compare a full-time computing degree with two commerce awards at the same Eachanari campus.
Published programme pages describe six-semester study and the academic entry route.
Published commerce pages distinguish degree study from optional professional coaching.
thingsToConsider: Current itemised fees and teaching language require direct confirmation.
CA coaching and AI-oriented study tracks should be distinguished from the underlying university degree and separate professional examinations.
Other schools and legacy college programmes require individual current qualification and approval checks.
bestFitFor: Applicants comparing regular computer-science and commerce study in Coimbatore.
School leavers seeking full-time six-semester commerce study.
Applicants who will obtain written confirmation of current fees and programme conditions.

faq.question: Where is Rathinam Global?
faq.answer: The university is at Rathinam Techzone, Pollachi Road, Eachanari, Coimbatore641021.

faq.question: What is its university status?
faq.answer: The UGC current university register lists Rathinam Global as a deemed-to-be university under Section3.

faq.question: Which programmes are included here?
faq.answer: B.Sc Computer Science, B.Com Professional Accounting and B.Com Computer Applications are included as three regular full-time undergraduate awards.

faq.question: How long do these degrees take?
faq.answer: The current programme pages describe three years and six semesters.

faq.question: What school qualification is required?
faq.answer: The listed undergraduate routes require a school-leaving/HSC qualification. Check the exact programme entry conditions and complete university verification.

faq.question: Does the accounting degree confer CA status?
faq.answer: No. The Professional Accounting degree offers an optional CA study pathway; professional qualification requires the separate applicable examinations and conditions.

faq.question: What are the fees?
faq.answer: Obtain a current written itemised quote for the exact degree and applicant category; a reliable current amount is not established here.

faq.question: Can overseas applicants use these listings?
faq.answer: International qualification equivalence and applicant permissions require separate university confirmation. These records verify the stated domestic academic entry route.
